description: GTFS Крагујевац is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Serbia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Град Крагујевац. Скуп података садржи податке о функционисању система јавног градског превоза на територији града Крагујевца у складу са GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) стандардом. Подаци обухватају информације о превознику, стајалиштима, линијама, појединачним вожњама, редовима вожње, временима долазака и полазака, као и трасама кретања возила када су доступне. Coverage: Град Крагујевац. The publisher named on the listing is Град Крагујевац. Its keywords include public-transport, mobility, stajalista, trase-linija, autobus, bus. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data License - Serbian Open Data Portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-serbia.
